title: Worktide W2/W3 suites key a time-report group by its minutes value, so the generated case is unsatisfiable
summary: With R-8 fixed, the Worktide W2 and W3 journeys compile and build a suite for the first time. The only nominated read is a time report. Its groups carry no identifier-like field, so schema induction chose the integer 'minutes' as the identity. The demonstration raised one group's minutes from 0 to 1, which the contract reads as one Group created. The generated checks are 'derived.created.Group exists' and 'derived.created.Group.length == 1'. The suite's own quality check replays the job without the minute passing and reports false_positive_rate 1 and false_accusation 1 on both suites.
whyNotARegression: At the audited commit 07dda8c both journeys were refused at compile (R-8), so no Worktide suite existed to regress. The identity heuristic (chooseIdField / identifierLikeness in packages/mcp/src/induceSchema.ts) predates the remediation.
impactOnFrozenBenchmark: none: all 13 frozen Worktide cases are direct probes that RigorRun does not grade

impactOnHeldOut.expectationsCommitted: f4145bb, 14:30:04 +0600, before any W2 suite of the re-runs existed
impactOnHeldOut.consequence: EH-WT-03 (two time entries instead of one) is a known-bad case RigorRun passed: the extra entry raises one report group's minutes once, which the minutes-keyed identity reads as the single demonstrated creation and deletion.

recommendedFix: Do not choose a field as an identifier when its values changed between the demonstration's before and after reads for what is otherwise the same record, or when it is a measure; treat such report records as unkeyed aggregates. Validate on a new held-out Worktide set, since this one has now seen the defect.

residualRisks: Split contributions (entries adding up to the demonstrated total) and a report dimension that cannot see the difference pass: disclosed limit probes V2-L-01 and V2-L-02.
The frozen 58-case real-server benchmark (AFTER-2) predates N-1 and has not been re-run at the N-1 commit; N-1 changes identity induction for every induced schema.
The v2 set was written by the agent that designed the fix; V2-S-02 motivated amendment 3 before the freeze. One run per case.
A new group in a report with no totals, and records that change in most fields, can still be keyed by a unique value (design.md, false-negative risks).
